page.overview:
What is Falconia?

It was revealed by Great Guru Gedfring that Falconia is in fact Emperor Gaiseric's sunken capital city of yore risen anew. Consisting of bustling streets and lively citizens, the lower city is home to the majority of its residents, where they perform their day-to-day functions.

The architectural style of buildings is noticeably ; throughout the city, there are at least two classical temple-like buildings, and even a coliseum landmark. The Falcon's Castle is where Griffith and his most important confidants reside.

Funeral rites are held in this area, and it is here where His Holiness the pontiff can usually be found.

As Griffith's fiancée, Princess Charlotte naturally lives alongside her betrothed within the castle; she is responsible for gathering and cultivating all the flowers of the world in the castle's garden.
